audit.whatIsWrong: Row 0 read Skill while whys[0] says you out-range her at level 1; row 5 read Skill while whys[5] says a fed Neeko out-bursts you; row 6 read Skill while whys[6] says you reclaim the advantage. All three disagree with packet.levelChart and with the mirror.
audit.why: The mirror (neeko__ziggs) already flipped exactly these three rows — 0 to Ziggs, 5 to Neeko, 6 to Ziggs — and left rows 1-3 as Skill. Matching it keeps the two directions consistent and stops the page rendering 'Skill' above prose that names a winner.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side + win[0] to Ziggs (5/10 -> 6/10); phases[5].side + win[5] to Neeko; phases[6].side + win[6] to Ziggs (4/10 -> 6/10). phases[5].why rewritten because it was describing your Blackfire Torch spike on a row that belongs to her.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was named as her window with no timer on it, and phases[5].why claimed the first-item row for you.
audit.why: Pop Blossom is 120/105/90s with a 600 range. That is a long enough gap that surviving one is worth two minutes of free lane, and it is the reason the first-item row belongs to her only if the level 6 combo actually landed.
audit.corrected: 120s and the 600 range written into spikes[1].text; phases[5].why restated as her spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tangle-Barbs is named as the thing to track in eleven strings and its 1000 range is never stated — the page implies you can simply out-range it, when it reaches 150 further than your Bouncing Bomb. Its 12s cooldown is absent. dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[0].d were filler ('the lane briefly belongs to you', 'don't audition for it'). phases[0].why called Neeko a melee tool.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs (E) is 1000 range on 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and grows larger, faster and longer-rooting after passing through a champion — so eating it in a minion wave is materially different from eating it clean. Blooming Burst (Q) is 800 to your 850, so your poke edge is 50 units, not a class gap.
audit.corrected: Real ranges into phases[0].why and breakdown.cooldowns; 12s into dosFull[2].d; the growth rule into dontsFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pop Blossom's hidden wind-up while disguised was implied but never stated as the mechanic.
audit.why: Riot's text says outright that the preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised — that is why fog and unexpected 'allies' are the danger, not her walk-up.

edits.before: Q bombs out-range every melee tool in the game — chunk Neeko on every last-hit attempt, but respect early minion aggro.
edits.after: Blooming Burst reaches 800 to your 850 — take the level 1 poke from the far edge and stay off the seed's second bloom.

edits.before: Blackfire Torch spike — your Q chunks become unhealable burn chip. Neeko now chooses between farm and HP every wave.
edits.after: Her spike if the level 6 combo landed — a fed Neeko bursts you before Blackfire Torch chip ever pays off. Play safe.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. It governs your forward steps. - W Satchel spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — it roots from 1000, further than your Q, and returns in 12s. Sidestep it behind minions. - W Satchel spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: Neeko whiffs Tangle-Barbs (Root) and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs whiffed means 12 seconds where she cannot start a fight.

edits.before: That is Neeko’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs grows and roots longer after passing a champion.

edits.before: This is Neeko's window: R Pop Blossom plus a Flash or her W Shapesplitter clone can leap onto you for a full stun-and-burst combo, so hold W Satchel Charge to knock yourself out and never stand in fog where a disguised Neeko is walking up.
edits.after: This is her window: Pop Blossom leaps from 600 for a knockup into stun, and its wind-up is hidden while she is disguised. Hold Satchel Charge — 20s at rank 1 — and never facecheck fog once her 120s ult is up, because a Shapesplitter clone can walk in first.

notes: Chart rows 0, 5 and 6 proposed as one atomic pair-matched group, matching the mirror and packet.levelChart; rows 1-3 left as Skill exactly as the mirror left them.
